title: Democrats Win Control of Congress
summary:
Voters across the United States have given the Democratic Party control of Congress. In the midterm elections on Tuesday, Democrats won the House of Representatives and the Senate. Before this, President Donald Trump's Republican Party held both.

Midterm elections happen in the middle of a president's four-year term. Voters choose all House members and about one third of the Senate.

The Associated Press reported that many voters were worried about high prices, a war involving Iran, and problems with corruption in government. Democrats won races in many states, from Texas to Iowa to New Hampshire.

Democratic leaders said the results show that people want big changes. President Trump said he accepts the results, but he plans to block laws that Democrats pass if he disagrees with them.

Democratic leaders also say they will look closely at the president and his team. That means Trump's last two years in office will have much more debate, and Congress will watch him much more closely.
why_it_matters: The people who win elections make rules about prices and schools, so election results can change everyday life for families like yours.
